_note: MDS-Onto study stages and MDSDom domains/subdomains. Every generated class and property is tagged with these (mds:hasStudyStage, mds:hasDomain, mds:hasSubDomain).

study_stages.Synthesis: making the material or device (supported by a Recipe)
study_stages.Sample: the physical specimen, device or material under study (supported by a Tool; fed by subsequent investigation)
study_stages.Exposure: subjecting samples to stressors or environments (weathering, damp heat, UV, field exposure)
study_stages.Characterization: measuring or imaging samples (instruments, techniques, measured signals)
study_stages.Data: raw recorded data (images, spectra, curves, time series)
study_stages.Data Processing: cleaning, transforming or extracting features from data
study_stages.Results: quantities and outcomes obtained (efficiency, Voc, degradation rate)
study_stages.Modeling: physical, statistical or ML models and simulations
study_stages.Inference: conclusions and predictions drawn from models or analysis
